task_prompt: You are given the following quantum programming task. Use Stim to generate a distance-7 repetition code memory experiment (15 rounds, depolarizing noise 0.03), decode with PyMatching, and print the logical error rate over 20000 shots. Provide a complete, self-contained program that runs as-is and prints its results.
